summary: ChatGPT CDP, Project Source transport, and profile-runtime routing belong in ops-cdp-core. Deprecated flakes and cdp proof trees are migration evidence or temporary runtime evidence, not a second canonical route.

Generic ChatGPT auth, a reachable CDP port, a stale profile, or a deprecated/raw script path can look successful while the target Project URL still redirects to login or cannot read Project Source. Profile resolution must prove the target Project route itself.

The normal Project transport route should be ops-cdp-core project-transport wrappers: probe the requested Project URL, upload to Project Source, verify visibility/readback, create or read the target Project thread with short pointer text, and keep semanticApproval/completionApproval/routeDecision false.
